messages:
alex: Quick check — I'm thinking we standardize on a deterministic token fingerprint as the canonical key for billing events. Reason: stable joins, cheaper downstream joins, and it survives re-ingest. Thoughts?

maria: +1 for a stable key but we must avoid leaking PII. Proposal: fingerprint = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_salt, user_identifier) where tenant_salt is managed in KMS. Also include a versioned prefix so we can rotate.

sam: Collisions are practically impossible with sha256, but replay/dup detection is bigger. Recommend envelope fields: fingerprint, event_id (uuid), seq_window, tokens, model_ref, ctx_len, attribution_path.

jen: Cost note — storing full raw envelopes for long retention is expensive. Can we split hot append-only ledger (N days) + compacted aggregates per-fingerprint for daily billing queries?

alex: Exactly. Two-phase storage: raw append-only event log for 14 days (fast replay), compacted per-fingerprint daily aggregates (queryable), then cold archive (S3/Glacier) for audits.

maria: Late-arriving events will mutate aggregates. We need a reconciliation window and anti-entropy jobs. Also consider emitting explicit finalization events (watermarks) per-tenant to mark a partition as stable.

sam: Finalizer should be idempotent. Finalization event carries final_token_delta + final_version. Reconciler applies a patch to aggregates; keep operation log for audits.

jen: We also have to record model_variant + quantization flags in the envelope so chargebacks are accurate (cost depends on model/quant).

alex: Draft ingest contract (pseudo JSON):
```
{
  "fingerprint": "v1:...",
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "model_ref": "redwood/open-rlhf-1.0",
  "tokens_delta": 42,
  "timestamp": "2025-04-03T12:34:56Z",
  "provenance": { "origin": "api", "request_id": "r_abc" },
  "attrs": { "is_cached": false }
}
```
(we'll formalize as a proto)

maria: Need to capture attribution_path for multi-call flows (user -> assistant -> tool -> assistant). Make it an array of spans with roles and token splits. This is critical for accurate per-product attribution.

sam: Performance Q: compute fingerprint at the edge (SDK/proxy) vs at the collector. Edge reduces duplicates early but increases client CPU and moves keying responsibility to customers. Tradeoff to discuss.

jen: Ops: allow backfill when fingerprint algorithm changes. Keep a fingerprint_versions table and provide re-hash/reconciliation jobs. Also add a migration header to archived events.

alex: Proposed next steps: spin RFC follow-up. Owner: @maria to draft ingest proto + storage tiers. Action items: (1) proto v1 draft, (2) retention/cost estimates for hot/compacted/archive, (3) reconciliation playbook for late arrivals & finalizers. Target: EOW for a first pass.

maria: I can take owner. I'll post a proto sketch tomorrow with examples for late-arrival flows and anti-entropy.

deploy-bot: CI check — metering-proto tests failed in staging: missing property assertion for finalizer idempotency.

sam: noted — I'll debug the failing test after lunch and follow up here.

jen: :thumbsup:
